name: Garwood Grill
statusNote: Shipped concept/pitch site, live. Deliberately dressed to the client's own brand, not the house style; explicitly labeled not the official Garwood Grill site, and the menu is marked illustrative.
oneLiner: A one-page concept site for an old-school Pembina Highway diner — all-day breakfast, char-grilled steaks, homestyle classics — built speculatively as a pitch.

components.name: index.html
components.desc: Single-page site: sticky nav with mobile toggle, hero, stats strip, About, filterable menu, Signatures grid, reviews, Visit section with hours and embedded map

components.name: Menu filter
components.desc: Category buttons with JS show/hide; menu labeled sample — prices and items are illustrative

dataFlow: Single scrolling page; nav anchors move within the document — no page-to-page navigation.
CTAs are tel: click-to-call links plus an external Apple Maps link and an embedded Google Maps iframe — no contact form.
pitch.html runs header to lead to what's included to pricing cards to disclaimer to a mail CTA.
integrations: Google Fonts (Alfa Slab One, Bitter, Oswald)
Unsplash stock photography (hot-linked, no assets folder)
Embedded Google Maps iframe (public embed, no API key)
decisions: Dressed to the client's brand, not the house style — warm diner palette (maroon, cream, gold, green) with a retro slab display font.
Menu explicitly labeled as a sample so nothing on the page overpromises.
No contact form, analytics, or CMS — a static page a diner can actually own.
Mobile hamburger nav for the phone-first audience.
